briefs.title: FDA expedited IND pilot: development readiness
briefs.summary: Assess program participation, submission readiness and cross-functional controls. No direct expedited safety-reporting rule change is established by this source bundle.

briefs.title: EMA masking: outbound ICSR controls
briefs.summary: The addendum defines destination-specific masking/blank/preservation groups for EudraVigilance ICSR submissions. Available data in 13 listed fields use MSK; 11 other fields are left blank. Available fields in the two preservation tables remain available under their applicable implementation guidance. Company current controls, applicability and implementation gaps remain unconfirmed.

sources.title: GVP Module VI Addendum II — masking personal data in EudraVigilance ICSRs
sources.observation: Supported-edition table extraction identifies 13 mask-when-available, 11 blank, 185 PV-preservation and 73 technical-preservation field references.

briefs.reconciliation: Preserve field-specific qualifications and missing-data behavior. No verified predecessor baseline or company gap is established.

manager: Assess destination-scoped outbound mappings, transformations and overrides.
Keep reporting clocks separate from privacy policy.
Confirm installed release and field-specific implementation guidance before proposing a setting.
scientist: Check that clinically relevant information is not removed through blanket masking.
Review qualifications on narrative and patient information with privacy and regulatory specialists.
lead: Confirm sender responsibility, destinations and review ownership.
Approve a scoped implementation and executed validation before closure.

dates.note: Sender implementation timing has qualifications; do not infer a fixed grace deadline.

proposals.text: Determine all company and partner EudraVigilance sender responsibilities and clinical/marketed scope.
Apply the 13-field conditional MSK policy only to confirmed EudraVigilance outbound mappings.
Omit or leave blank the 11 Table 2 fields according to the applicable XML specification; do not use unsupported nullFlavors.
Preserve available Table 3–4 data under the applicable implementation guidance and established pseudonymisation controls.
Verify destination routing, local customizations, partner transformations and report-form confidentiality options independently.
Document a reasonable implementation timeframe and how the sender will achieve it in internal procedures.
Perform schema/business-rule checks plus explicit masking checks; a gateway ACK alone is insufficient evidence of the masking policy.
Maintain controlled source records, vendor/partner agreements, SOPs and controlled change history.
Train case processors, reporting operations, systems support, QA and relevant partners on field groups and exceptions.
Implement through company change control with backup, rollback, independent review and post-change verification.
